value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 in any stream. Central and many other universities admit through CUET-UG, where the subject itself can be one of the tests counted; others admit on Class 12 marks or their own test. Some universities fix the major at admission; others, under the NEP four-year programme, let students settle it after the first year.

value.title: At a glance
items: The syllabus overlaps heavily with UPSC and state PSC general studies (polity, governance, international relations).
Jobs with a bachelor's include policy research assistance, journalism, political consulting, NGO and advocacy work, and public-affairs roles.
Think-tank and international-relations roles usually expect a master's degree.
Common next steps: an M.A. in Political Science, International Relations or Public Policy, a 3-year LL.B, or civil-services preparation.
